nodes.label: Correcao F03: limitador antes do JSON, cache de readiness, IPv6, allowlist de peers

nodes.norm_label: plano f03: limitador barato antes do parsing e readiness com cache

nodes.label: Fase F: catalogo publico controlado (DTO, cursor AES-GCM, preco oculto, wa.me)
nodes.norm_label: fase f: catalogo publico controlado (dto, cursor aes-gcm, preco oculto, wa.me)

nodes.label: Rate limiting em memoria e contador Firestore por IP/janela
nodes.norm_label: rate limiting em memoria e contador firestore por ip/janela

nodes.label: F03 Caminhos HTTP contornam limitacao privada / readiness publico
nodes.norm_label: f03 caminhos http contornam limitacao privada / readiness publico

nodes.label: 20,000-Source Capacity Fixtures
nodes.rationale: Direct-seeded fixtures prove structural completability of cancellation and return with 20,000 sources, but do not replace 20,000 real HTTP receipts or certify production performance/cost.

nodes.label: F02 Batch Budget Limits (150 reads, 100 writes)
nodes.norm_label: f02 batch budget limits (150 reads, 100 writes)

nodes.label: Execution Lease and Fence
nodes.rationale: Admin resume re-authenticates and takes a new fence; an expired lease never releases money, order or batch. Sealed fence identifies proof, current fence guards the executor.

nodes.label: 409 FINANCIAL_RESUMABLE_REQUIRED
nodes.rationale: More than 100 payments/applications must use the resumable path before history is loaded; the old atomic path stays 200 for small histories.

nodes.label: F02 Resumable Financial Resolution Executor
nodes.rationale: Cancellation/return of orders with very many payments cannot fit one Firestore transaction, so a durable, resumable executor applies bounded batches and publishes one final financial state; no new commercial limit is imposed.

nodes.label: Cheap Per-IP HTTP Limiter Before JSON/Auth
nodes.norm_label: cheap per-ip http limiter before json/auth
nodes.rationale: Limiter precedes express.json, auth and SDK so invalid/oversized/valid requests all consume the same quota; key cardinality capped at 10,000 per instance.

nodes.label: Durable Image Cleanup Jobs
nodes.rationale: Upload candidate is persisted before Storage; retired images get a 24h grace job; uploading jobs are not reclaimed by age because an in-flight RPC may still complete.

nodes.label: Node 22.23.3 Runtime Pinning and Build Smoke Test
nodes.norm_label: node 22.23.3 runtime pinning and build smoke test

nodes.label: Health Ready/Live Probes with Coalesced Firestore Read
nodes.norm_label: health ready/live probes with coalesced firestore read

nodes.label: Retention and TTL Policy
nodes.rationale: TTL declared only for rateLimits (not deployed); administrative idempotency records are never TTL'd because deleting the key would reopen replay; financial ledger/proofs/audit retention is untouched.

nodes.label: Read/Document Timeouts and Concurrency Slots
nodes.rationale: Hung SDK RPCs keep their slot until completion rather than freeing capacity for more hung RPCs; 503 REQUEST_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN on command timeout with idempotent retry; reads capped by a 32 MiB memory budget.

nodes.label: Customer Wallets (carteira) and Assignment
nodes.rationale: Sellers only edit their own customers; no automatic redistribution when a profile changes, admin transfers wallets explicitly; versioned transactional revalidation prevents overwriting recent decisions.

nodes.label: Private Product Images (WebP via API)
nodes.rationale: Bucket and Rules deny direct access; API revalidates identity/tenant and serves re-encoded WebP no-store; no public URL is ever generated.

nodes.label: Product Price in Cents and Units (UN/CX/PCT/KG/L)
nodes.norm_label: product price in cents and units (un/cx/pct/kg/l)

nodes.label: Transactional Unique-Key Reservations (SKU, CPF/CNPJ)
nodes.rationale: Inactive records keep document/SKU reserved; changing the key releases the old reservation and acquires the new one in the same transaction.

nodes.label: Immutable Stock Movement Ledger with Hash Chain
nodes.norm_label: immutable stock movement ledger with hash chain
nodes.rationale: No PATCH/DELETE of movements; corrections create compensating adjustments.

nodes.label: Order Stock Contract (prepare/apply)
nodes.rationale: Interface prepare(tx)->apply() forces all reads before writes within the order transaction; implemented by Phase D adapter.

nodes.label: Scaled Integer Quantities (scale 1000, text over HTTP)
nodes.norm_label: scaled integer quantities (scale 1000, text over http)
nodes.rationale: Quantities as decimal strings avoid float errors; BigInt validation then exact integer scale 1000 internally.

nodes.label: Administrator Discount Approval with Fingerprint
nodes.rationale: Any edit invalidates approval; price/condition changes return DISCOUNT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED even for admins, so seller cannot gain unreviewed benefits.

nodes.label: Seller Order Access via Order Owner AND Current Wallet
nodes.norm_label: seller order access via order owner and current wallet

nodes.label: Damaged Goods Separate Ledger and acceptedCents Decision
nodes.norm_label: damaged goods separate ledger and acceptedcents decision

nodes.label: damagedValueReductionCents Cumulative Reduction
nodes.rationale: Absent field in historical docs means zero so existing proofs/hashes remain unchanged; reduction already decided never reappears in later returns.

nodes.label: Dispatched Order Returns (intent, physical receipt, resolution)
nodes.norm_label: dispatched order returns (intent, physical receipt, resolution)
nodes.rationale: Intent blocks the order without moving stock; stock changes only on physical receipt of sellable units; financial resolution is a separate administrative step.

nodes.label: Financial Cancellation of Confirmed Order
nodes.rationale: Cancels debt, restores previously applied credits to their sources and destines only settled cash to new credit or refund obligation, in one commit with stock release.

nodes.label: financialTitles Derived Projection
nodes.rationale: Projection derived from Phase D receivables without rewriting history; invariant original = open + cash + credit + canceled.

nodes.label: Payment Conditions and Methods (presets, weights, 12 installments)
nodes.norm_label: payment conditions and methods (presets, weights, 12 installments)

nodes.label: Manual Payments and Allocated Receipts (reject excess)
nodes.norm_label: manual payments and allocated receipts (reject excess)
nodes.rationale: Excess over balance rejected, no automatic credit from overpayment; receipts allocate to titles of a single order.

nodes.label: Refund Obligations and Manual Confirmation
nodes.rationale: No bank integration; an obligation does not mean money returned, only a manual confirmation does.

nodes.label: Global catalogSlugs Registry (old slugs stay reserved)
nodes.norm_label: global catalogslugs registry (old slugs stay reserved)
nodes.rationale: Old slugs remain reserved to the owner tenant to prevent link hijacking, though only the current slug resolves.

nodes.label: Public Catalog Routes (no login, slug-resolved tenant)
nodes.norm_label: public catalog routes (no login, slug-resolved tenant)
nodes.rationale: Server resolves tenant from slug, publishes only active/catalogVisible products, never tenant/SKU/stock/financial; unknown/disabled/blocked catalogs share one unavailable response.

nodes.label: Public Catalog Rate Limiting (memory + Firestore buckets)
nodes.norm_label: public catalog rate limiting (memory + firestore buckets)

nodes.label: Quote Preview and HMAC reviewToken
nodes.rationale: Stateless: nothing is persisted; HMAC proof over current public data forces re-review on change and excludes hidden prices.

nodes.label: Commercial Order PDF (not a fiscal document)
nodes.norm_label: commercial order pdf (not a fiscal document)

nodes.label: Paged Administrative CSV Exports
nodes.rationale: One page per download with signed cursor in X-Next-Cursor; formula injection neutralized; no global snapshot across pages.

nodes.label: Document Download Limits and Quota (8 MiB, 2 slots, 30/hour)
nodes.norm_label: document download limits and quota (8 mib, 2 slots, 30/hour)

nodes.label: Packing Slip (Romaneio) PDF without financials
nodes.rationale: Free-text commercial notes are excluded because they may contain financial data; requested, dispatched and physically returned quantities are kept separate.

nodes.label: PDFKit Renderer with Embedded Liberation Sans
nodes.norm_label: pdfkit renderer with embedded liberation sans
nodes.rationale: Native Node generation avoids Chromium, remote HTML and Storage; fontkit checks glyph coverage and rejects unsupported text instead of silent substitution.

nodes.label: Phase D - Orders, Reservations, Initial Receivables
nodes.norm_label: phase d - orders, reservations, initial receivables

nodes.label: Phase F - Public Catalog and Quotes
nodes.norm_label: phase f - public catalog and quotes

nodes.label: Sealed Proof Entries with Incremental Merkle
nodes.norm_label: sealed proof entries with incremental merkle
nodes.rationale: Immutable proof entries with exact-body backup and a bounded-frontier Merkle build avoid whole-history arrays; missing entries are recovered only from the verifiable sealed body, altered bodies are never overwritten.

nodes.label: Trust Proxy Policy (TRUST_PROXY_HOPS=0)
nodes.rationale: Hop-count trust is rejected; only explicit IPs/CIDRs are trusted, and only after Cloud Run ingress topology is validated, to prevent X-Forwarded-For spoofing of rate-limit keys.

nodes.label: Central tenant authorization gate
nodes.rationale: Services revalidate authorization inside write transactions; identity, tenant and subscription are re-read without permission cache to avoid stale decisions after suspension or role change.

nodes.label: Capacity model (active members + valid pending invitations)
nodes.norm_label: capacity model (active members + valid pending invitations)

nodes.label: Platform operator separated from tenant roles
nodes.norm_label: platform operator separated from tenant roles
nodes.rationale: No Super Admin role within tenant profiles; platform role alone cannot access tenant data.

nodes.label: Firestore rules deny direct client access; Admin SDK enforces authorization
nodes.norm_label: firestore rules deny direct client access; admin sdk enforces authorization

nodes.label: Subscription state machine (active/past_due/suspended/canceled)
nodes.rationale: canceled is terminal; past_due keeps access in manual MVP; suspended/canceled block private access and public catalog.

nodes.label: Specific permission keys (receivables:read, payments:manage, returns:manage, catalog:manage ...)
nodes.norm_label: specific permission keys (receivables:read, payments:manage, returns:manage, catalog:manage ...)

nodes.label: Permission matrix (administrator / seller / platform without membership)
nodes.norm_label: permission matrix (administrator / seller / platform without membership)

nodes.label: Recent authentication requirement (<=300s)
nodes.rationale: Sensitive financial/return operations require fresh login; future timestamps >30s rejected; permission re-read inside commit and replay.

nodes.label: Role/status change rules (keep one active administrator)
nodes.norm_label: role/status change rules (keep one active administrator)

nodes.label: ADR 0001 Identidade global e vinculo por empresa
nodes.norm_label: adr 0001 identidade global e vinculo por empresa
nodes.rationale: Firebase Auth identifica a pessoa; vinculo por tenant define perfil e estado. Permite multiplas empresas sem duplicar senhas nem confundir cliente comercial com usuario; custo: consultas de autorizacao no servidor. Sem claims desatualizados; desativar um vinculo nao revoga os outros.

nodes.label: ADR 0002 Admissao transacional (capacidade e administrador)
nodes.rationale: Usuarios ativos + convites pendentes ocupam vagas. Admissao serializada por empresa com auditoria na transacao evita estourar limite e remover o ultimo administrador. Documento da empresa e ponto de contencao aceito para poucos usuarios; nao usar como contador global de vendas.

nodes.label: ADR 0003 Planos versionados
nodes.rationale: Planos tem versoes preservadas; assinaturas recebem snapshots e condicoes especificas com motivo. Impede que mudanca da oferta global altere silenciosamente contratos vigentes. Condicoes da piloto pertencem a assinatura, sem valores especiais presumidos.

nodes.label: Idempotency records / operations (no TTL)
nodes.rationale: No TTL enabled: removing a record would allow repeating a movement/operation; requires approved retention/replay policy.

nodes.label: Composite index cost vs query flexibility (125-126 indexes, not deployed)
nodes.norm_label: composite index cost vs query flexibility (125-126 indexes, not deployed)

nodes.label: Inventory movement hash chain and reconciliation
nodes.norm_label: inventory movement hash chain and reconciliation

nodes.label: Seller scope: own portfolio and own orders
nodes.norm_label: seller scope: own portfolio and own orders

nodes.label: Fase B - clientes, produtos, categorias, imagens
nodes.norm_label: fase b - clientes, produtos, categorias, imagens

nodes.label: ADR 0004 Carteiras e unicidade transacional
nodes.rationale: Cliente comercial distinto de identidade/tenant. Responsavel e vendedor ativo validado pelo backend. CPF/CNPJ e SKU tem reservas por hash no tenant, protegendo corridas sem varredura e permitindo mesma chave em outra empresa. Busca por prefixo e paginacao indexada em vez de texto completo/offset; filtros flexiveis custam indices.

nodes.label: ADR 0005 Imagens privadas e associacao versionada
nodes.norm_label: adr 0005 imagens privadas e associacao versionada
nodes.rationale: Recodifica WebP sem metadados, objeto privado sem download token. Firestore e Storage sem transacao conjunta: objeto imutavel salvo antes da associacao versionada; falha remove so o objeto da tentativa. Contrapartida: orfaos sem limpeza automatica, pendencia antes de producao.

nodes.label: ADR 0006 Estoque serializado por produto
nodes.rationale: Agregado por tenant/produto (escala 1000) com movimento imutavel, idempotencia e auditoria atomicos. Projecao de reposicao evita varredura ao custo de indices. Unidade trava apos primeira movimentacao. Reconciliacao paginada com hash encadeado, sem reparo automatico.

nodes.label: Completion criteria (financialCompleted, COMPLETED, publishedAt)
nodes.rationale: POST 202 is not financial completion; applied==total never means completion.

nodes.label: Lease and fencing token for executor takeover
nodes.norm_label: lease and fencing token for executor takeover

nodes.norm_label: pending homologation (20k real receipts, quotas, cloud run)
